summary: TOMI Environmental Solutions filed an 8-K disclosing mutual termination of its June 28, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Carbonium Core, Inc., under which TOMZ Merger Sub, Inc. would have merged into Carbonium, leaving Carbonium a wholly owned TOMI subsidiary. Termination, effective September 15, 2026, followed the September 11, 2026 outside date under Section 10.1(b); both parties cited TOMI's financial condition, strategic direction, and adverse due-diligence findings on Carbonium's operations and projected performance. No termination fee is payable; each party bears its own expenses. Watch for strategic alternatives and financing risk.
